extra.message: User-controlled 'host' parameter is directly concatenated into a shell command via os.system(). An attacker who knows the internal ops token can supply a value like '127.0.0.1; cat /etc/passwd' to execute arbitrary OS commands.

cwe: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command (OS Command Injection)

extra.message: User-controlled 'fragment' parameter is directly concatenated into a Jinja2 Template string and rendered. An attacker can inject arbitrary Python expressions or access the app context via {{ config.__class__.__init__.__globals__['os'].popen('id').read() }}. The template body at line 93 ('Result: ' + fragment) is executed during render.

cwe: CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code (Code Injection)

extra.message: User-controlled 'name' parameter from a Form field is used directly as a filename without path sanitization. A value containing '../' can traverse beyond BASE_EXPORT_DIR and write arbitrary files on the filesystem via Path / name pattern.

cwe: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (Path Traversal)

extra.message: An authorization bearer token from request headers is logged in plaintext via logger.warning(). This exposes authentication credentials to any log reader and violates CWE-532 guidance.
